steps.title: Start a new round
steps.text: Reveal safe cells and use adjacent counts to avoid mines. This generated board is a game, not a detector-data analysis. Press Restart when you are ready to replace the current round.

await.hint: Press Restart in the game header.

steps.title: Read the controls
steps.text: Move with the arrow keys, reveal with Enter or Space, flag with F, and restart with R or Esc. Mouse buttons reveal or flag cells. Help explains difficulty changes and the board rules.

await.hint: Press Help in the game header.

steps.title: Check the fresh round
steps.text: Close the help window, then press Restart once more. Check that the board is covered and the flags are cleared at the current difficulty. The guide waits for your click; it never presses a control for you.

await.hint: Press Restart in the game header and inspect the reset round.
